auditScope: Presence-led Brand AI Visibility v1 — read-only production readiness

blockingIssues.severity: Brand client UI/HTML still exposes Recommendation Rate, Recommendation Share, Top-3 Rec, First Rec Rate, and Questions Won column labels, tooltips, KPI cards, and question-tab copy that imply recommendation semantics not certified for Brand v1.

All Providers mode scaffolds primary portfolio/overview metrics from a single measured provider (scaffoldProvider) while only attaching derived cross-provider Presence for the top brand. Primary KPIs are therefore not a pure derived All Providers view.
Executive Portfolio Snapshot still renders a Questions Won KPI tile (blocked First-driven metric), competing with Presence-led narrative even when publication-gated to unavailable.
Client/read availability taxonomy does not distinctly surface Provider Error vs Unavailable vs Not Monitored; provider execution errors exist in adapters but collapse on Brand read surfaces.

Recurring monitoring scheduler is disabled (SCHEDULER_ENABLED=false). Checkpoint/idempotency foundations exist, but production biweekly durability, automated retry, and ops status for client trust are not live.

nonBlockingIssues.severity: Insight evidenceRefs are string keys, not clickable drilldowns to metric→evidence chains.
Detail insight boxes are partially client-synthesized; responseId is in drilldownTrace but not primary drawer meta.
Trend points filtered by provider/geo/language at query time; consecutive points are not pairwise validated via compareTrendObservations (promptFamily/methodology only when both sides populated).
Cross-provider comparability currently stamps synthetic promptFamily=portfolio_presence, which can overstate cohort comparability across provider windows.
Executive summary performs brand×geography monitoring resolves plus per-provider presence loops; WeakMap summary cache helps but no pagination on questions/evidence lists.
Publication gate correctly nulls blocked metric values (not zero), but unavailable recommendation columns remain visible clutter.
NOT_COMPARABLE and INSUFFICIENT_COMPARABLE_HISTORY exist in libraries; All Providers / portfolio UI does not always elevate these states as first-class banners beside KPIs.

dimensionNotes.DATA_INTEGRITY: Observed/Zero/Not Monitored/Unavailable/Partial exist; publication gate prevents blocked→0. Gaps: All Providers scaffold bleed; NOT_COMPARABLE not always UI-primary.
dimensionNotes.CROSS_PROVIDER: Derived measures + no arbitrary scores implemented. Gaps: scaffold primary metrics; synthetic promptFamily; top-brand-only XP block.
dimensionNotes.EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY: Insights cover strongest/weakest/missing/change/watch; competitive gap and provider disagreement when evidence exists. Gaps: Questions Won tile; recommendation table columns.
dimensionNotes.DETAILED_VIEW: Evidence drawer + drilldownTrace cover metric→provider→prompt→response→entity→citations. Gaps: responseId prominence; recommendation-centric question tabs.
dimensionNotes.LANGUAGE_SAFETY: FAIL — recommendation vocabulary dominant in Brand client chrome despite blocked signals.
dimensionNotes.TRENDS: INSUFFICIENT_COMPARABLE_HISTORY and language/provider/geo filters present; pairwise methodology/prompt cohort checks incomplete.
dimensionNotes.FAILURE_STATES: Partial/Not Monitored/Unavailable/Zero/NOT_COMPARABLE/Insufficient History exist; Provider Error not client-distinct.
dimensionNotes.INSIGHT_TRACEABILITY: Deterministic boxes include Finding/Evidence/So What/What to Watch + evidenceRefs; no freeform LLM.
dimensionNotes.PERFORMANCE: Parallel loads + summary cache; N+1 and payload size remain hardening items.
dimensionNotes.AUTHORIZATION: Entitlement graph + resolveAiIntelligenceAccess on every brandId; DEEP vs COMPARATIVE; API is read-only.
dimensionNotes.MONITORING_DURABILITY: Orchestrator checkpoint/unique-key foundations; scheduler off; not production-ops ready.

prioritizedHardeningPlan.title: Presence-led UI chrome purge
actions: Remove or Future-Ready-hide Recommendation Rate/Share/Top-3/First/Questions Won columns, KPIs, tooltips, and Won-tab framing from Brand client
Keep publication gate as fail-closed backstop
Rewrite question help copy to Presence/Missing language

prioritizedHardeningPlan.title: All Providers pure derived mode
actions: When provider=all, do not present scaffoldProvider metrics as primary KPIs
Tighten comparability keys (real prompt family + monitoring window)

prioritizedHardeningPlan.title: Client failure-state grammar
actions: Map Provider Error / Partial Monitoring / Not Comparable / Insufficient History as distinct from Zero Presence
Banner these states on Exec + Detail

prioritizedHardeningPlan.title: Trend pairwise comparability
actions: Apply compareTrendObservations between consecutive points before charting deltas
Return INSUFFICIENT_COMPARABLE_HISTORY when methodology/prompt cohort diverge

prioritizedHardeningPlan.title: Monitoring durability for client release
actions: Define controlled-release monitoring SOP (even if scheduler stays manual)
Do not claim automated biweekly until SCHEDULER_ENABLED with gates

prioritizedHardeningPlan.title: Performance pass
actions: Cap executive N+1 resolves; paginate questions/evidence
Defer secondary panels (already partial) + trim payload fields
